title: Draw
description: One draw result. Unique key: market + draw_date + session + draw_type.

draw_type.description: Draw format. Always 4D in this release.

draw_date.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) under which the compiled archives list the draw.

session.description: Draw time label HH:MM as published by the compiled archives, in WIB (Asia/Jakarta). A label, not a verified timestamp.

session_timezone.description: Time zone of the session label. Not the local time zone of the market.

result.description: Four-digit result as a string. Leading zeros are significant ("0678").
